Inside the sculpture

From a mark to a movement.

This is your Meshy-generated model, animated with a lightweight spine rig. Soft skin weights and cubic animation curves keep the movement continuous.

A 9-bone armature separates the pulsing bell from the trailing tentacles. A swimming loop travels with the model, ready to import into Blender or another GLB-compatible 3D tool.
